aperture_validity.basis: the source marks surface 7 as the stop with a zero spacing to surface 8, so the opening coincides with surface 8's clear aperture; the engine carries it as that surface's aperture and builds no separate plate (conversion counts report aperture_stops 0)
aperture_validity.consequence: the stop-dependent aperture is present as the clear aperture of surface 8, but there is no opaque plate outside it, so the record is not eligible for stop-dependent evaluation
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: no separate blocking plate and no stop-dependent evidence in this batch

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED air wavelength 587.56 nm (the d line, the wavelength the source's Nd refers to), converted once to vacuum with the engine's own air model (6432.8 / 2949810 / 25540, material_physics.air_index_exact)
spectrum.wavelength_precision: full precision as used by the Project; rounded values are for display only

sampling_span_nm.note: the source states indices at the d line only; the +/-0.5 nm window is a numerical convenience, not a second wavelength and not a measured band

continuous_coverage_nm.note: the source states no operating wavelength range

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Signed paraxial effective focal length of the native Project.

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Signed paraxial distance from the last optical surface vertex to the rear focal point for collimated input.

total_track_mm.definition: Axial distance from the first optical surface to the image plane.

engine_check.method: thick-lens paraxial ABCD through the committed Project's COMPOUND unit

comparison.rule: per quantity: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * scale, with scale = |EFL| for the effective focal length and max(|BFL|, |EFL|) for the back focal length. atol = 0.005 mm is half a unit in the last decimal of the coarsest focal length these publications print (two decimals); rtol = 2e-3 is 1e-3 for a prescription printed to four decimals on radii as small as 0.27 mm plus 1e-3 for the engine's air-referenced index convention

effective_focal_length.basis: the source states no such first-order value

back_focal_length.basis: the source states no such first-order value

comparison.why: the publication states neither an effective focal length nor a back focal length for this example, so the two-quantity rule has no pair to judge. The engine's values are recorded under engine_check as ENGINE_COMPUTED facts and no verdict is claimed

nominal_effective_focal_length_mm.note: the publication states no effective focal length for this example, only an F-number range across examples

nominal_back_focal_length_mm.definition: from the last surface vertex to the paraxial image point

entrance_pupil_f_number.definition: Magnitude of effective focal length divided by the admitted axial entrance pupil diameter.

field.note: the publication's parameter table states an F-number, a half angle of view and an image height per example, but this batch did not confirm which row belongs to this table, so no field value is asserted

materials.policy: Every glass is a constant index at the source's stated Nd. A patent table gives Nd and vd only, which cannot define a dispersion curve; fitting one would invent a material.

approximations.detail: every glass is a constant index at the source's stated Nd; the stated vd is recorded but no dispersion curve is modelled, so axial colour is not represented
the Project is evaluated at the d line only
surface 2 of the source table is a plane with air on both sides and a zero spacing to surface 3; it was merged away, so surface 1 now carries the combined 0.2000 mm spacing to surface 3

the source's stop (surface 7) has a zero spacing to surface 8. A zero spacing cannot be represented, and a nominal gap would invent geometry, so the stop is carried as surface 8's clear aperture. The opening is preserved; the opaque plate outside it is not modelled, and the record states STOP_NOT_BLOCKING

the source states no clear apertures; semi-diameters were derived from the F-number and capped where the source's own radii would otherwise make surfaces 4 and 5 intersect (0.20 mm on the front groups, 0.22 mm on the rear group, 0.40 mm on the cover plates). They set the stop plate and the solid checks, not the first-order values
the source states no object distance; the Project is built for an object at infinity
the source gives no stop-plate outer radius; the plate reaches the largest clear semi-diameter beside the stop
nominal prescription surfaces; no figure, centring or surface-roughness error is modelled

wavelength_band_nm.basis: the intersection of the valid bands of the materials and coatings used
